verdict.rationale: Featurebase explicitly documents automatic notification of users when their requested feature ships ("Featurebase automatically notifies all relevant users when their requests are shipped. No more manual follow-ups."), directly matching the story, and this is reinforced by webhooks for status-change events enabling further custom automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the notification behavior and detail on configurability (e.g., channels, opt-out) beyond the marketing claim.
